RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently prove discrimination. For a "head of group" role, commercial skills, leadership style, and client relationships often outweigh additional years of technical design experience. Eight years of experience with strong client ties may legitimately fit their strategic needs better.

Raising gender bias based purely on the panel's demographics is legally unsubstantiated and could severely damage your professional reputation in the industry. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen future leadership applications. Only reconsider if written feedback reveals explicit bias or concrete procedural irregularities.
